title: fix(memory-wiki): preserve cache publications on unchanged compiles
body:
Supersedes #171166, thanks @alkor2000.
Related: #168784.

## What Problem This Solves

An explicit Memory Wiki compile replaces and deletes its accepted cache publication even when the vault and compiled output have not changed.

## User Impact

Repeated unchanged compiles preserve the publication ID, persisted row, metadata, and bytes. Changed sources or output, missing rows, and corrupt rows still trigger replacement. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing publication writer validates the persisted predecessor before deciding to reuse it. The compiler supplies its already captured source-identity comparison while holding the existing vault mutation lock. Prompt reads keep their existing warm cache.

The replacement adds no reuse wrapper or snapshot-builder extraction. Production grows by 23 lines because persisted validation, cancellation, and owner continuity are needed; there is no equivalent dead code in this owner area to remove safely. Regression tests grow by 54 lines, with a matching allocation for the real compiler/SQLite boundary coverage.

## Evidence

- Current-main base: `ecb25a3dd58a12e4d7890e16eba194090a36ed70`. The new real compiler/SQLite regression fails on main for both warm and cold unchanged compiles (2 failures, 4 invalidation controls passing; 10.64 seconds wrapper time).
- Fixed candidate: all 19 cache lifecycle integration cases pass (15.08 seconds Vitest / 16.69 seconds wrapper), including unchanged row/byte retention and replacement for source edits, unprojected source edits, changed persisted output, missing rows, and corrupt rows. Compiler and payload ownership suites add 12 passing cases (3.27 seconds Vitest).
- Focused production and test-consumer types, type-aware lint, formatting, whitespace, line-cap and test-line checks pass locally. Full exact-head [PR CI run 41282684485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41282684485) passed for `d8ea90b9c2973d9a153b98e6ca09e0da794165e6` (445 seconds elapsed; the extension-proof job took 214 seconds including setup). No broad suites ran on the Team host.
- Local autoreview, Codex P0–P2, reviewed the complete candidate (committed unchanged as `d8ea90b9c2973d9a153b98e6ca09e0da794165e6`) against the base above with full compiler/cache and mutation/lifecycle context: scoped-clean, no actionable findings. The review was static; it did not rerun tests.
- Contributor code was read through GitHub only and was never checked out or executed. This is an independent implementation with verified human co-author credit.
- Proof covers the real compiler and SQLite owner, including cold owner activation. No public CLI/Gateway, installed upgrade, concurrent-process or crash/power-loss proof is claimed. No Team Gateway or live state was changed.
